sloka: न नास्तिकानां वचनं ब्रवीम्यहं न नास्तिकोऽहं न च नास्ति किञ्चन।समीक्ष्य कालं पुनरास्तिकोऽभवं भवेय काले पुनरेव नास्तिकः॥२.१०९.३८॥
transliteration: na nāstikānāṁ vacanaṁ bravīmyahaṁ na nāstiko'haṁ na ca nāsti kiñcana।samīkṣya kālaṁ punarāstiko'bhavaṁ bhaveya kāle punareva nāstikaḥ॥2.109.38॥

translations.english: I do not speak the language of atheists. I am not an atheist. I do not say that the next world does not exist. In keeping with time (occasion) I shall speak the language of a believer or a nonbeliever.
